acceptance: A replay of waves 159 to 183 gives one open alert and not 22 items.
The alert names the cause fields of the breach and the next action.
A new breach in an open alert does not file an item.
fix: Design review first. Replace the item for each wave with one open alert for the breach, with a count and a trend. The alert names the largest cause from the record (live lane share, host gate share) and the next action. A repeat adds to the open alert and does not file an item. A fix closes it.
summary: The loop.warning of 2026-11-21T08:20:16Z says the wave latency budget was exceeded in 22 waves, 159 to 183. Each wave filed a latency-wave-breach inbox item, each was consumed, and the budget stayed exceeded. The alert has no owner action, so it trained the console to ignore the family.
title: The wave latency breach raises one alert with an owner and an action, not one item for each wave
